svg.title: Renew evidence explicitly and respect delayed-feedback margin
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Renew evidence explicitly and respect delayed-feedback margin
Executed gate: unqualified packet at 20 ms changes no evidence
24 ms: supplied complete qualification; 27 ms: carrier reset.
Scalar remote integrator: control latency τ = 10 ms
10 Hz → 54°; 20 Hz → 18°; 50 Hz exceeds the 25 Hz first stability limit.
Remote control age includes delivery, processing and actuation; not just RF propagation.
The 24 ms qualification is an external evidence input, not a demonstrated reacquisition time.
Actual sampled / variable-delay / bounded-actuator stability requires further analysis.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
